name: Mako Barchet
source: A strange girl trying to kill Kotaro. She attacks him on orders of an unknown person. She seems to know Kazuha, Saeko, and Mao from somewhere. Is very confused by Kotaro acting nice towards her despite her best efforts to kill him. Hates that no one can say her family name correctly.
